title: Interaction Atlas of Amines with Lignocellulose Monomers: docked complexes, DLPNO-CCSD(T)/LED interaction energies, proton-transfer and nucleophilic reaction paths
description: Interactive atlas and underlying data for a computational study of amine (ethylamine, dimethylamine, diethylamine, triethylamine, DMB, DME) interactions with lignocellulose monomers (lignin units, Tricin, hydroxycinnamates, stilbene, and carbohydrate/uronic-acid units). Contents: 72 docked substrate-amine complexes (xyz), a pair table with docking energies and DLPNO-CCSD(T) interaction energies with Local Energy Decomposition (LED) components, ORCA 6.0 output files, a proton-transfer path set, a nucleophilic-reaction NEB path set and reaction network (GFN2-xTB, ALPB water), and the self-contained interactive web atlas. This is a snapshot: a subset of DLPNO calculations did not finish and are being rerun (see README).
